scripts.build:static: next build --webpack && cp public/_headers out/ && cp public/_redirects out/ && rm -rf out/_functions
scripts.release:zip: pnpm run build:static && ZIP_NAME="broadwaykebab-static-build-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).zip" && rm -f "$ZIP_NAME" && (cd out && zip -r "../$ZIP_NAME" . -x '*.DS_Store') && echo "Created $ZIP_NAME"
scripts.deploy:github: GITHUB_PAGES=true pnpm run build:static && touch out/.nojekyll
scripts.deploy:vercel: pnpm run build:static && echo 'Upload out/ directory to Vercel'
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm run build:static && echo 'Upload out/ directory to Cloudflare Pages'
